prompt_templates.CAP-READ-FORMULA: Read the supplied formula as structured notation. Identify symbols, any coefficient, any subscript and any charge before interpreting it.
prompt_templates.CAP-PARSE-ION-CHARGE: Read the supplied ion notation. Distinguish ionic charge from subscripts or coefficients and state the charge without changing the species.
prompt_templates.CAP-TRANSLATE-PARTICLE-SYMBOL: Translate the supplied particle or symbolic representation into the requested representation while preserving chemical identity and count.
prompt_templates.CAP-CHECK-ATOM-CONSERVATION: Use an atom-count ledger to check the supplied process representation. State the first mismatch or confirm the required conservation check.
prompt_templates.CAP-CLASSIFY-CHANGE-EVIDENCE: State the decisive supplied evidence first, then classify the process only from that evidence and the authorized criterion.
prompt_templates.CAP-CHECK-RULE-EXCEPTION: Apply the supplied rule only after checking the recorded condition or exception. State which feature controls the decision.
prompt_templates.CAP-PRESERVE-REACTION-CONDITION: Read or rewrite the supplied reaction while preserving the recorded condition and explain why the condition cannot be dropped from the representation.
prompt_templates.CAP-SEPARATE-OBSERVATION-INFERENCE: Write the supplied observation and the supported inference separately, then state the evidence link without overclaiming.
prompt_templates.CAP-READ-APPARATUS-METHOD: Use the supplied apparatus representation to link the target property or observation to the relevant method feature.
prompt_templates.CAP-TRACK-REACTING-SPECIES: Track each supplied reacting species from before to after the process before assigning any role label.
prompt_templates.CAP-ATTACH-SPECIES-ROLE: After tracking the supplied species, attach the requested role only to the reactant species whose equation evidence supports it.
prompt_templates.CAP-VERIFY-CHEMICAL-REPRESENTATION: Run the required independent chemical checks on the supplied result or representation before accepting it.

CAP-READ-FORMULA: Locate each notation feature by position.
State the local meaning of each feature.
CAP-PARSE-ION-CHARGE: Locate the superscript charge separately from subscripts/coefficients.
Verify the species identity is unchanged.
CAP-TRANSLATE-PARTICLE-SYMBOL: Translate one feature at a time.
CAP-CHECK-ATOM-CONSERVATION: Count each required atom before and after.
Compare counts and identify any mismatch.
CAP-CLASSIFY-CHANGE-EVIDENCE: Classify only after the evidence matches the criterion.
CAP-CHECK-RULE-EXCEPTION: Apply or withhold the rule accordingly.
CAP-PRESERVE-REACTION-CONDITION: Keep it attached to the process representation.
Check that the rewritten/read representation preserves it.
CAP-SEPARATE-OBSERVATION-INFERENCE: Explain exactly how the observation supports the claim.
CAP-READ-APPARATUS-METHOD: Identify the target property or observation.
CAP-TRACK-REACTING-SPECIES: Track each corresponding species after the process.
CAP-ATTACH-SPECIES-ROLE: Use its recorded change/effect as evidence.
Attach the requested role and exclude spectators.
CAP-VERIFY-CHEMICAL-REPRESENTATION: Repair any failed check and re-run it.

stage_modifiers.GUIDED: Use explicit first-move and representation cues.
stage_modifiers.FADED: Remove one supplied cue and require the learner to choose the next move.
stage_modifiers.INDEPENDENT: Provide no procedural cue beyond the task and source-authorized representation.
stage_modifiers.PROBE: Use one discriminating prompt only; do not teach before evidence is collected.
